description: Create a new decision monitor that watches for rate changes and sends webhook notifications when conditions are met. Returns the monitor with a webhook_signing_secret for verifying webhook payloads.

conditions.description: Array of conditions that must be met to trigger the monitor. Required.

operator.description: Comparison operator (lt=less than, lte=less than or equal, gt=greater than, gte=greater than or equal, eq=equal, change_pct=percentage change).

cooldown_hours.description: Minimum hours between webhook triggers (1-168). Defaults to 24.

decision_context.description: The context for evaluating rate changes. Required.

product_type.description: Type of loan product. Defaults to "mortgage".

state.description: US state code (2-letter, e.g., CA, TX, NY). Required.

term_months.description: Loan term in months (12-480). Defaults to 360 (30-year mortgage).

name.description: A descriptive name for the monitor. Required.

subscribed_product_types.description: Optional array of product types to monitor (e.g., ["30yr_fixed", "15yr_fixed"]).

subscribed_states.description: Optional array of state codes to monitor. If not provided, monitors all states.

webhook_url.description: The URL to send webhook notifications to. Required.

name: create_monitor

outputSchema.description: Result of creating a rate monitor. The webhook signing secret is returned once and never again.

important.description: Warning that the signing secret will not be shown again.

conditions.description: Trigger conditions evaluated against rate changes.

cooldown_hours.description: Minimum hours between two triggers of this monitor.

decision_context.description: Stored decision context (loan amount, term, intent) used when evaluating triggers.

id.description: Monitor id, used by get_monitor / update_monitor / delete_monitor.

subscribed_states.description: Two-letter state codes the monitor watches.

webhook_signing_secret.description: HMAC secret for verifying webhook payloads. Shown only on creation.

webhook_url.description: URL that fires when the monitor triggers.

summary.description: One-line confirmation naming the monitor that was created.
